item.title: ESP32 Bit Pirate: Bridging Modern Microcontrollers and Browser-Based Hardware Debugging
item.description: ESP32 Bit Pirate project integrates multi-protocol debugging within a browser environment using HTML5 APIs. It enables users to install firmware and interact with microcontrollers like the ESP32-S3 directly from the browser. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Meta Open-Sources Astryx, its Agent-Ready React Design System
item.description: Meta recently announced the beta release of Astryx, an open-source React design system developed internally over eight years. (1 source: infoq)
